text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the specific nature of the pain and confirm if it radiates down one leg or both? I also need to know if you have experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in that leg.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any loss of bladder or bowel control, or notice any weakness in your foot, such as difficulty lifting your toes? I also need to know if you have any history of similar episodes or recent trauma other than the gym activity.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any numbness or tingling in the leg or foot, and can you confirm if you have full control over your bladder and bowel functions? I would like to perform a physical examination of your lower back and leg strength now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To further assess the extent of the nerve involvement, can you tell me if you have any difficulty lifting your big toe or standing on your tiptoes? Also, does the pain worsen when you cough, sneeze, or strain?
